 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending to his arrest relating to FIR/Crime No.1159/2023 dated 20-03-2023 registered at Police Station , Waidhan District Singrauli for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code.

2 . It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that as per allegations levelled by the prosecution, it is apparent that the present applicant has been made an accused alleging his involvement in preparation of a forged death certificate of Bansilal Mallah.
It is contended by the learned counsel that there are no specific allegations against the present applicant.
The present applicant only has signed as a witness in the sale-deed executed in favour of the complainant - Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal and his wife - Smt. Rajkumari Jaiswal.

1 3.

sentences.text: It is contended by the counsel that even the complainant has not alleged anything against the present applicant.
The present applicant is the cousin brother of the complainant - Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal and he is also working as a Primary Teacher in the Govt. Primary School, Naudihawa Naveen, District Singrauli.
It is thus, contended by the learned counsel that the present applicant deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant and submits that since the present applicant has also signed the sale-deed which was executed after preparation of a forged death certificate and as the present applicant has signed in the capacity of a witness, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.
5.

Having considered the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, prima facie, it is gathered from the case of the prosecution that implication of the present applicant is based on the fact that,
he in the capacity of a witness, has signed the sale-deed.

The complainant - Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal and his wife Smt. Rajkumari Jaiswal, have not deposed anything adverse against the present applicant and he is also cousin brother of the complainant - Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal and is also a government servant.
6. Thus, taking into consideration totality of the circumstances, without commenting on merits of the case, this application filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. stands also allowed.

7 . It is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant Gulaab Prasad Jaiswal by the Police in the aforesaid crime, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting officer (Investigating Officer) for his regular appearance before the Police during the investigation or before the Court during the trial.

The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and Gulaab Prasad Jaiswal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179383307/
